judgment.rationale: The report demonstrates high fidelity to the provided evidence universe. It correctly maps technical feasibility to the 2024 case study (AE05S) and NIST guidance (DE_DE04_0B017D64401987E4), while explicitly preserving the technical limitation regarding distributed low-rate attacks (AE05C). Institutional enablement is grounded in NIST ISCM and IDPS guidance (DE_DE07_E2C403C2FF05BA09, DE_DE04_0B77B88875745973). The financial/adoption dimension is correctly marked as unresolved, citing both benefits (automation/integration) and burdens (specialized skills) without inventing numeric budget or ROI data. The report is exceptionally disciplined regarding the forecast: it correctly identifies the PMT state as publication activity (NoP) and the threat state as NoI, noting that the provided DBIR and Mandiant records are observed context rather than trajectory evidence.
